headline: Front-Line Ledger Stirs in Nevish and Weathered
war_summary: Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse has supplied the freshest movement, recording six base events in the latest two hours and 50 across the current 24-hour window; its holdings remain divided among Wardens, Colonials, and two neutral bases. Nevish Line still leads the war’s activity ledger with 69 events, though none arrived in the latest two hours; its balance stands at six Warden and two Colonial bases. Kuura Strand’s rolling tally has eased to 22 events, with two in six hours but none in the latest two, while Faden Point and Talven remain the busiest named bases. Marban Hollow shows 15 events and no movement in six hours, with four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base. Linn Mercy has risen to 13 events, including two in six hours, and remains split eight Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral. Godcrofts records six events, but no fresh action in two hours. Stlican Shelf’s three events and heavy casualty traffic merit watch, though its latest recorded movement is older. The war remains undecided.
